basis: User-approved Chinese glosses, interpreted against preserved PokéAPI fields and variable definitions; never an upstream translation.

triggers.shed: 蜕壳时产生额外宝可梦
triggers.three-critical-hits: 一场对战中命中要害三次
triggers.take-damage: 受到伤害后前往指定地点
triggers.three-defeated-bisharp: 击败三只携带头领凭证的劈斩司令
triggers.gimmighoul-coins: 收集 999 枚索财灵的硬币
triggers.meltan-candies: Pokémon GO 中使用 400 颗美录坦糖果

special_edges.zh: 土居忍士进化为铁面忍者时，蜕壳产生的额外宝可梦
special_edges.en: An extra Pokémon produced from the shed shell when Nincada evolves into Ninjask.
special_edges.basis: Preserved level-up and shed edges are separate; the shed edge has no min_level, item or party-space fields.

scope.zh: 第三世代《红宝石／蓝宝石／绿宝石》《火红／叶绿》：队伍至少留一个空位；不需要额外准备普通精灵球。
scope.en: Generation III Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald and FireRed/LeafGreen: keep a party slot open; no extra regular Poké Ball is required.

scope.zh: 第四世代《钻石／珍珠／白金》《心金／魂银》：队伍至少留一个空位，包中至少有一个普通精灵球；会消耗该球，并非任意球类都可替代。
scope.en: Generation IV Diamond/Pearl/Platinum and HeartGold/SoulSilver: keep a party slot open and a regular Poké Ball in the Bag; that ball is consumed. Other ball types do not substitute.

supplements.scope_note_zh: 这些是独立核实的版本补充，并非 PokéAPI 原始条件字段；未将其外推到其他游戏或特殊获取方式。
supplements.scope_note_en: These separately verified version notes are not raw PokéAPI conditions; no applicability is inferred for other games or acquisition methods.
